ns2:section.sectionText: PIR Dialogue Course for INTERSECTIONS Living-Learning Community - Race/Ethnicity. 7 week class. 1 hour (letter-graded) credit. 42474 IN3 Tuesdays 3:30-5:20 pm. Location: Carr Con Must be an Intersections Living Learning Community resident to enroll. No enrollments open to any students outside of the Intersections Living-Learning Community in Housing. See: www.intergrouprelations.uiuc.edu for courses and enrollment information on other Dialogue Course Opportunities. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call the PIR Office at 244-3356 or Domonic Cobb in Housing at 333-0770.
